plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, talks about the Hypogeum, an ancient underground chamber on the island of Malta. He says long, stretched skulls were found inside it, said to lack the normal seam that runs along the top of a human skull, and that one is on display in a museum in Valletta, Malta's capital. If true, it would hint that someone unlike ordinary humans once lived there.
